tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Greek geōrgos, 'farmer', from gē, 'earth', + ergon, 'work'. Its root is Greek geōrgos (γεωργός). Saint George, the dragon-slayer and martyr. George is a Greek name meaning “Farmer; earth-worker”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
